Brother Faceless

Biography

Brother Faceless appears among the brothers of the Last Shelter, claiming to hide a face disfigured by torture. Khatul trusts him to guide Zak toward the Portal. This identity is a disguise: at their later meeting the former village elder Erfar the Silvertongue reveals himself and explains how he has arranged for the guards to intercept Zak. [1, 2, 3, 4]
